verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches GitHub's permission model. Fine-grained personal access tokens are granted a defined set of permissions that limit which resources they can reach, and a community comment notes that protected branches and code owners exist as branch-level controls on paid private repos. Nothing documents assigning roles or permissions to users or teams across the requested scopes. Missing for 10: documented organization-level role assignment, project-level permissions, repository role/permission assignment for users and teams, environment-level protection rules or required reviewers, first-party docs on branch protection, and independent corroboration.
